title: Vivid Malaysian Noodle Soup
description: A spicy and flavorful noodle soup inspired by Malaysian cuisine, perfect for a quick lunch. This recipe combines the brightness of vivid ingredients with the warmth of traditional Malaysian spices.

ingredients.name: Vivid
ingredients.notes: Use vivid chili paste for added heat

ingredients.name: Malaysian
ingredients.notes: Use Malaysian curry powder for authentic flavor

ingredients.name: Noodle
ingredients.notes: Use thin rice noodles for a traditional texture

ingredients.name: Noodles
ingredients.notes: Add additional noodles for a heartier soup

instructions: Heat the vivid chili paste in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the Malaysian curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add 4 cups of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Add the egg and cook until set.
Add the noodles to the pot and cook according to package instructions.
Season the soup with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional vivid ingredients if desired.
